best_transferable_mechanisms.name: Produce the next consumer physical representation directly, with cold immutable weight/scale layout preparation
evidence: layers/linear.py:13-24,65-79 (block32, packed UE8M0, aligned scale layout; weight scale transformed in constructor)
layers/tilelang_ops/norm.py:23-63,65-110,154-166 (explicit output buffers and logical/physical scale views)
layers/tilelang_ops/cuda/norm.py:231-246,258-282,288-324 (input-dtype residual RNE; norm; original-dtype RNE before FP8 quantization; optional simultaneous BF16 output)
models/v4_modules/mlp.py:259-300,534-544 (post-load packed weights, normalization writes directly to final SymmBuffer input/scale slots)
models/v4_modules/attn.py:111-148,151-210 (cold Q/Wv layout permutation, fused norm/RoPE/attention and consumer-ready FP8 output)
best_transferable_mechanisms.what_it_removes: Separate activation cast, scale repack and intermediate materialization when the actual selected consumer needs that representation. Cold weight conversion is shared rather than repeated per decode slot.
best_transferable_mechanisms.hyle_mapping: Use existing cold Region proposals/representation facts and PreparedOperation/Invocation; bind immutable derived artifacts to their actual provider/layout and budget, and preserve caller-visible logical tensors at escaping boundaries. Existing FP8 shared-prologue region and typed/packed routes are natural carriers; no second engine or model whitelist.
best_transferable_mechanisms.numeric_limit: This is explicit quantized math, not permission to transparently change ordinary BF16/F32 MatMul to FP8. Their norm kernel explicitly rounds through the input dtype before quantization. UE8M0 packed scale layout and model FP4/QAT assumptions are not Hyle current F32-scale FP8/NVFP4 contracts.
best_transferable_mechanisms.lifetime_limit: DeepInfer resizes original parameter storage after replacement in some cold repacks; Hyle must not copy that destructive action onto borrowed/mmap/constants still referenced by another plan, slot, capture or old result.
best_transferable_mechanisms.bounded_next_investigation: One supported quantized producer-consumer path: inventory actual cast/repack bytes and cold artifact reuse; only implement a fused output representation if a complete numerical/layout contract and real consumer exist. No claim of measured benefit here.

best_transferable_mechanisms.name: Complete projection plus residual/accumulation epilogue using the final output buffer
evidence: layers/linear.py:83-114 (32-byte padded physical output stride, logical slicing)
layers/linear.py:116-165 (out_acc passed as C to native GEMM and reused as D)
models/v4_modules/mlp.py:513-526,549-562 (shared down projection accumulates into existing routed-expert output)
best_transferable_mechanisms.what_it_removes: One temporary projection output and a following read/add/write pass when a native epilogue can implement the original result.
best_transferable_mechanisms.hyle_mapping: Existing cold MatMul/Add region qualification and native Provider output/alias/workspace contracts can represent this; retain the exact original BF16 output and residual-add rounding boundaries, control readers and no-escape proof.
best_transferable_mechanisms.numeric_limit: Vendor GEMM C accumulation may add C in the F32 accumulator before final BF16; that is not automatically equal to BF16(MatMul)->BF16 Add. Vendor kernel body is absent locally. A legal Hyle lowering must explicitly stage the original RNE(s), even if performed inside one epilogue.
best_transferable_mechanisms.bounded_next_investigation: A real supported projection+residual chain, identical bytes/strides/output publication and Completion boundary, source-matched independent rounding witness first. End-to-end benefit remains to be measured; no repeated whole-MMVF or already negative BF16-Top1 experiment is implied.

best_transferable_mechanisms.name: Keep accepted tokens and compact decode metadata on GPU across steps; overlap CPU scheduling without a new executor
evidence: worker/worker.py:89-180,191-243,248-271 (enqueue current forward before previous host postprocess; GPU prior sampled tokens/accepted lengths; explicit event when CPU really needs a result)
layers/tilelang_ops/prepare_v4_decode_metadata.py:9-105 (compact ragged per-sequence inputs produce many derived arrays with one metadata CTA kernel plus block-table expansion)
doc/inference_deployment_qa.md:262-280 (CPU budget/GPU exact per-request draft lengths)
best_transferable_mechanisms.hyle_mapping: After the requested actual MTP consumer is functional, reuse state versions/accepted-prefix and original invocation/transfer dependencies to test device-resident next-token and position/length inputs. Generic slots/state metadata should express dependencies; sampler policy remains engine-owned.
best_transferable_mechanisms.risk: Cancellation, stop tokens, old-result leases, failed Completion, selected state generation and rejected drafts must gate visibility. DeepInfer still performs explicit synchronization for required host postprocessing; zero-overhead is an overlap objective, not zero CPU cost or no waits.
best_transferable_mechanisms.current_limit: Current Hyle Qwen consumer is a correctness/performance test product without MTP; this source does not justify silently changing its public per-token host observation or rewriting Graph capture/configuration.

already_aligned_not_a_new_redesign.DeepInfer: worker/cuda_graph_runner.py:41-51,92-110,125-151 builds finite batch sizes; one max source/device/output allocation sliced per variant; reverse capture and shared graph memory pool; stable metadata addresses and small replay handle.
already_aligned_not_a_new_redesign.Hyle: tools/qwen35_text/main.cc already has exact finite child family and phase slots; src/graph/executable.cc/resources.cc already preserve eligible physical binding facts across configuration metadata refresh (D1), while keeping current permission/lease checks. already_aligned_not_a_new_redesign.ownership_difference: DeepInfer max output/pool slices are reused by its sequential runtime. resource_layout_lesson.mechanism: KVCacheFormat separates quantized element semantics, scale encoding, physical byte type, per-token bytes and stride alignment; block/state cache allocators carve aligned views and share only explicitly mapped prior layers. One token interleaves data and encoded scales rather than materializing dense cache for attention.
resource_layout_lesson.hyle_limit: Useful for explicit native representation and byte-budget facts; V4.1 compressed/SWA/share-KV format is model-specific. Bounded replay in Q&A is explicitly approximate and depends on V4.1 window/backtracking/YOCO; not a generic mathematically equivalent Qwen optimization.

confidence_head_dependency.fact: DSpark confidence scheduling consumes a learned acceptance-rate predictor projection weight (and optional Markov correction), loaded from the final draft module. It is not obtained for free from an arbitrary MTP head or a generic TopK probability.
confidence_head_dependency.local_Qwen_fact: Exactly15 mtp.* BF16 tensors; no confidence/accept_rate key in the whole inspected safetensor header.
confidence_head_dependency.decision: Keep requested stage6 actual Qwen fixed draft/verify consumer separate from DSpark learned-confidence scheduling; the latter requires an actual compatible trained head, numerical contract and calibration/acceptance evidence.

distributed_mechanisms_not_directly_tran: models/v4_modules/mlp.py:184-201,254-321,528-560: mega-MoE is a DeepGEMM call using EP group/NVL-domain qualification, prepacked experts and SymmBuffer, optional shared expert fusion and fast_math=True. One Python call does not prove one CUDA kernel; absent vendor bodies prevent inspecting its scheduling details or assuming singleton efficiency.

parallel_utils/userbuffer.py:40-50,65-96 reserves SMs for communication and manages process-wide EP/symmetric buffers; appropriate only with the corresponding concurrent communication workload. Do not reserve SMs on a single idle-communication GPU by imitation.

Wide EP64-128, EPLB expert replication/shuffle, DP balancing, disaggregated prefill/decode, GDR and3FS cache retention target cluster services and fall outside this single-machine/one-GPU base-library task.
Published throughput, batch-invariant mode and speculative verification gains are operating-point/model dependent; they are not established on Hyle supported hardware or ordinary BF16 Qwen.
deepinfer.recommended_result: Retain current Hyle cold-plan/provider/Invocation architecture. Highest-value next source-guided work is exact producer-output layout with shared cold weight artifacts, then a complete projection/residual epilogue whose BF16 boundaries are proven; device-resident MTP metadata belongs after the actual requested MTP consumer works. No new model, runtime, global cache or governance mechanism follows from this review.

recipe.main_finding: deepseek-recipe0.2.0 is actual protocol/prompt/tokenizer/image-preprocessing code, with mock server examples and an application-provided inference callback. It is not vLLM or a GPU inference recipe. V4.1-Flash names select prompt/API semantics, not model math. There is no numerical singleGPU optimization to port from this repository.

negative_scan.interpretation: Absence corroborates explicit ownership docs and reviewed callback code; a keyword scan alone would not prove absence of all optimization.

runtime_axes.fusion_graphcapture: No transformer decode fusion, static GPU graph or capture implementation. PreparedRequest means rendered protocol request.
runtime_axes.precision_kernels: No model W/A/Y dtypes, quantization, BF16/FP8 kernel or device/kernel chooser; f32 sampling/logprob fields are metadata.
runtime_axes.KV_state_memory: PromptUsage receives backend-reported cache-hit token counts; it does not implement KV/cache/model-state storage. Actual state is CPU token/parser buffers and encoded-image byte reservations.
runtime_axes.multiGPU: No weights, TP/EP ranks, NCCL/collectives or sharding assumptions. Adapter is hardware-agnostic; this supplies neither singleGPU nor multiGPU performance evidence.

three_boundary_takeaways.finding: Canonical request and output events remain independent of model compute.
three_boundary_takeaways.actual_implementation: ConversationRequest separates inference, parsing and response options. PreparedRequest holds rendered prompt/images; callback produces ordered Ready/Text/Tokens/Finish events. Model-dependent top_p/defaults stay in request conversion. OutputConstraint is description/prompt data, not an implemented grammar-mask decoder.
three_boundary_takeaways.hyle_owner: Engine/test consumer tools/qwen35_text/main.cc::Model and future caller adapters; existing include/hyle/graph/executable.h::Invocation and compute/sampling_ops.h stay generic.
three_boundary_takeaways.future_stage: Current steps4/5 interface/consumer boundary review; no new required server/API module. A future interactive consumer can adapt normalized input onto existing finite Graph invocations.
three_boundary_takeaways.next_action: Keep prompt/model/API policy outside per-token numerical submit. Reuse existing RNG/categorical/Completion seams; do not add DeepSeek model selectors, Rust/Python/HTTP dependencies or a second executor to Compute/Graph.
three_boundary_takeaways.singleGPU_implication: Keeps parsing/rendering off the numerical hot path; a design inference, not measured speedup.

three_boundary_takeaways.finding: Token-ID provenance, UTF8 buffering and stop/finish semantics are one incremental consumer contract.
three_boundary_takeaways.actual_implementation: Prompt.special_ranges distinguishes explicit control tokens from equal spelling in user text. PromptTokenizer prepares plain-vocabulary encoding once; StreamDecoder buffers incomplete UTF8 and preserves special IDs. StreamProcessor stops on finish/stop; Python iterator aclose is shielded on disconnect. Backend cleanup remains caller responsibility.
three_boundary_takeaways.hyle_owner: Test consumer token IDs/EOG in tools/qwen35_text/main.cc; future tokenizer/stream adapter above Graph. Existing Completion::request_cancel and Invocation::close/drain keep actual retirement and old-result ownership.
three_boundary_takeaways.future_stage: Step5 generation/stop boundary; accepted-token batch adaptation can inform later step6 MTP consumer without changing the MTP algorithm. Current token-tape consumer does not require a tokenizer/server project to finish.
three_boundary_takeaways.next_action: When a text stream is added, consume accepted token IDs, preserve boundary/type and separate stop-policy from retirement. Closing a stream may stop new admission; it does not prove an in-flight GPU kernel stopped or allow early buffer reuse.
three_boundary_takeaways.limits: Python example attaches no tokenizer and requires Text chunks; Tokens support is in the library. Vec/tokenizer/parser code is not a zero-allocation or decode-throughput guarantee.

three_boundary_takeaways.finding: Image preprocessing and token-budget bookkeeping do not provide a vision encoder/projector.
three_boundary_takeaways.actual_implementation: OpenCV reads headers, decodes/resizes/pads and re-encodes WebP; ImageByteBudget reserves concurrent encoded bytes and resolver commits quota only after success. MultiModalData computes image-token adjustment, used alongside exact encoded prompt length/context limits. The model encoder/mmproj is wholly external.
three_boundary_takeaways.hyle_owner: Future step7 image consumer preprocessing and semantic encoder/projector Graph; existing Tensor/Graph, ResourceBudget and native limits own actual numeric storage/execution.
three_boundary_takeaways.future_stage: Step7 mmproj/image-to-text only, after current pure-text foundation. This does not establish current multimodal support or a new current-goal missing server module.
three_boundary_takeaways.next_action: Keep context-token policy, encoded image bytes and actual typed/opaque GPU memory as distinct budgets. Implement and verify encoder/projector tensors/weights/math separately in step7; use generic existing math and lifetime paths.
three_boundary_takeaways.limits: Request quotas do not replace physical KV/device max-buffer or opaque allocation constraints; no image inference/kernel performance was demonstrated.

recipe.decision: Preserve the existing inference-library boundary. These are three consumer/interface lessons for existing stages, not evidence for new model support, a mandatory HTTP server, or numerical performance changes.
limits: No external repository build/test/server was run; no speed or correctness execution claim.
Local0.2.0/date/model-name evidence does not establish online release provenance; parent owns official web verification.
No claim that this repo implements vLLM, GPU inference, graph capture, precision recipes, KV/state scheduling, MTP or hardware acceleration.
